title: Aromatic Spanish Shrimp Salad
description: Garlicky Spanish shrimp salad with a hint of spice, served chilled. The dish combines shrimp, a vegetable stock cube, and a light vinaigrette.
instructions: Prepare a spherification bath by dissolving 1g sodium alginate in 1L water and stirring until clear.
In a separate bowl, mix 2 tbsp olive oil, minced garlic, smoked paprika, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.
Using a syringe, drop small droplets of the garlic oil mixture into the alginate bath to form micro-spheres; let them set for 2 minutes then transfer to cold water.
Pat dry the shrimp with paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and cook shrimp for 2 minutes each side until pink.
In a serving bowl, combine cooked shrimp, diced cucumber, cherry tomato halves, sliced olives, and fresh parsley.
Drizzle the garlic oil spheres over the salad and toss gently.
Serve immediately chilled, garnished with extra parsley if desired.
